item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Once you add credits, I can make this a professional headshot with a navy blazer, a neutral background, and balanced lighting while preserving your natural features.

style.prompt: Make this photo into a polished, photorealistic professional business headshot of the same man. Preserve his identity, recognizable facial features, age, short gray hair, and natural skin texture. Replace the gray T-shirt with a well-fitted navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt. Replace the kitchen background with a simple neutral gray studio backdrop. Use soft balanced professional portrait lighting, natural skin tones, and subtle restrained retouching. Keep the head-and-shoulders composition, direct gaze, and natural expression. Do not add text.
